payload.title: The refresh rate-limit bucket is 10 per 5 minutes per client IP and nothing else, so everyone behind one office address shares it (about 10 page loads per 5 minutes), and a user whose silent restore is throttled for longer than 20 s is sent to /login
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/resolvers/auth.resolver.ts:140 (@RateLimit name refresh, limit 10, window 5 minutes, per client IP)
web/shared-ui/src/utils/api-client.ts:540 (silentRefresh gives up after one short wait)
payload.rule_violated: A per-session budget (a hash of the refresh credential, never the credential) plus a larger per-IP abuse ceiling; a throttled page-load restore shows a reconnecting state, not the login page
payload.notes: A security-design change (SEC-HIGH-202 keyed the bucket on the end-client IP on purpose): needs its own review, not folded into the availability fix.
narrative: Everyone behind one office address shares 10 refreshes per 5 minutes. SEC-HIGH-202 chose the end-client IP on purpose, so a per-session budget is a security-design change that needs its own review.
